description: This file contains shell script source code for performing tests related to git rebase operations on a non-linear commit history with merges. It includes functions for setting up test scenarios, executing rebase commands with various options, and verifying the results.

methods.name: test_revision_subjects
methods.description: Checks that the git log subject lines match the expected string.

methods.description: Performs a rebase operation with specified options and verifies the expected outcome.
